Priya S: Canary complete for microcoalesce-v2 in us-east-1. Quick numbers: p95 -28%, p50 -11%, throughput +9%, estimated infra cost/1M tokens -18%. Small memory +1.5MB per worker.
Marco: nice! which traffic mix?
Priya S: Mixed dialogue workload (70% short 30% long), 90m steady window. Baseline p95 190ms -> 137ms on canary hosts.
Elaine: any error or stability signals?
Priya S: No sustained 5xx. CPU% slightly higher during merge bursts but within alert thresholds. KV evictions unchanged.
deploy-bot: canary rollout initiatied 2026-04-11T09:44:12Z (5 nodes).
ops-bot: monitoring: p95, 5xx, cpu, kv-evict. Auto-rollout paused until manual ack.
Priya S: Rollout plan: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% over 12h with gates. Rollback if p95 regresses >6% for 10m or 5xx >0.4% sustained.
Marco: link to perf diff?
Priya S: Dash: https://dash.redwood/internal/runs/4312345678, artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/microcoalesce-v2/4312345678.tar.gz
